pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/orchestrator/[...path]/route.ts:11 This context is a same-origin REST proxy, a typed fetch client and mock dashboard data. It neither exposes nor consumes a tool protocol: a case-insensitive search of src/lib and src/app/api/orchestrator for mcp, modelcontextprotocol, tools/call, tools/list, jsonrpc and inputSchema returned no hits, and 'tool' appears only as analytics row types (ToolUsageSummary) and mock narrative text.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/api.ts:48 Auth here gates a REST proxy that attaches a team key server-side. No tool-server tokens or tool listing are involved.
src/lib/api.ts:51 The transport is plain HTTP fetch to a JSON REST API. It does not choose between stdio and HTTP for a tool server.

src/app/api/orchestrator/[...path]/route.ts:47 The relayed upstream body is fenced for browser safety (JSON-only, nosniff, sandbox CSP). It is never fed to a model as a tool result, so model-facing fencing does not apply.
